caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden plaque with rounded upper corners, on which a relief sculpture of a lion is carved. The lion is shown in profile, walking left with its head turned slightly forward and down, mouth open to reveal its teeth, and a long tail curving upwards toward the right. The mane, facial features, and muscular body of the lion are detailed with fine, parallel hatching lines and shading to suggest texture and depth. The plaque appears to be brown, with wood grain patterns clearly visible. At the top two corners of the plaque, small circular metal loops are attached, possibly for hanging. There are three round nail or screw heads depicted along the lower edge of the plaque, suggesting it may be fixed to a surface. The background of the image is plain and off-white, and the artist's signature "J. SULLIVAN" is visible in the bottom right corner. Simple guideline marks are present at the corners of the paper.
title: Shop Sign
